mapper.select: SELECT st.id, st.school_id, s.school_name AS school_name, st.class_id, st.grade_id, c.class_name AS class_name, g.grade_name AS grade_name, NULL AS user_id, st.student_code AS student_number, st.student_name AS name, st.gender, st.phone, NULL AS id_card, NULL AS birthday, NULL AS enroll_date, st.bind_code, st.status, '' AS remark, st.create_time FROM student st LEFT JOIN school s ON st.school_id = s.id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON st.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN grade g ON st.grade_id = g.id WHERE st.id = #{id} AND st.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM student WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
